messages:
matt: Heads-up: canary promotion for `release-2026-04-01` was auto-paused by deploy-bot. CI failing on the cache upload step to remote cache (throttle errors).
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/build/cache-upload` failed with remote cache throttle errors. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/1769801234
anya: Paste from failing job:
```
[2026-04-01T09:07:41Z] uploading build cache to cache.redwood.internal
ERROR: PUT https://cache.redwood.internal/upload returned 429 Too Many Requests
retry 1/3 after 2s
ERROR: PUT https://cache.redwood.internal/upload returned 429 Too Many Requests
retry 2/3 after 4s
ERROR: upload failed: remote cache throttled, aborting
```
rachel: We rolled in a config change yesterday that enabled aggressive parallel cache uploads to speed CI. Looks like the registry-side rate limiter is tripping for this tenant.
ci-bot: Observed spike in parallel upload concurrency from recent pipelines starting at 2026-04-01T08:45Z. Throttling policy applied.
matt: Change window is open. Proposal: temporarily disable remote cache upload (fall back to local runner cache) in CI to unblock canary, then follow up with quota bump or backoff logic.
deploy-bot: Manual pipeline config rollback allowed. Automatic promotion remains blocked until a green run and manual approval.
anya: +1 to disable remote upload for the canary run. We'll need a short PR to flip the flag in CI and an accompanying note linking to the throttling events.
rachel: I'll open PR to disable remote cache upload and add exponential backoff + jitter to the uploader for the follow-up patch. Also adding a dashboard alert for cache 429 spikes.
deploy-bot: PR #6010 opened: ci: disable remote cache upload for canary. CI triggered.
deploy-bot: CI for PR #6010 completed: status=success (build and tests green without remote cache).
matt: Requesting manual promote now.
matt: /promote release-2026-04-01 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion request recorded. Required approvals: eng-releases (anya), eng-sre (rachel).
anya: Approved.
rachel: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary rollout 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Health checks passing. Promotion complete.
matt: Release unblocked. Creating follow-up ticket RW-4201: "remote cache 429 during parallel uploads: investigate rate limiter behavior, implement uploader backoff and per-pipeline concurrency cap, consider quota increase."
ci-bot: Suggested mitigation checklist added to RW-4201: add retry-with-jitter, reduce max concurrent uploads to 4, add dashboard/alert for >5 429s/min.
rachel: Draft release note: "Temporarily disabled remote cache upload in CI after transient 429 throttle errors impacted canary build; promotion manually approved while SRE addresses uploader backoff and quotas (RW-4201)."
anya: Thanks team for the quick pivot. I'll follow up on RW-4201 and send a postmortem when we have the next steps.
matt: Closing thread. Thanks everyone.
